changelog:
Initial release of floating-product-generator.

- Generate cinematic floating product images with dramatic studio lighting.
- Designed for e-commerce, ads, luxury branding, and creator content.
- Integrates with the Neta AI image generation API (API token required).
- Supports customizable image sizes and style reference via options.
- Easy command-line usage and quick start instructions included.
summary: Generate cinematic floating product shots, levitating product photography, and hovering e-commerce images with dramatic studio lighting — perfect for Shopify...
